data.rationale: The proposal follows the same path (menu, Bridges & Tunnels, toll rates by vehicle, pick vehicle type) and names vehicle type as a parameter, but it omits the facility parameter, starts with a vague "Fares & Tolls or menu" step, and gives no concrete element labels such as Agencies or Tolls by vehicle, so an automation would need guesswork.
